name: Natasha Rubinsky
source:
A forensic scientist specializing in on-site crime scene investigation, Natasha "Nat” Rubinsky is Sherri's longtime acquaintance and key source of information about police activity in the city. While the two are far from friends, Sherri's consistent ability to get results and Nat's authority to keep the cops away from her make for some very effective teamwork. Nat is aggressive, argumentative, caustic, and an overall pain in the ass...but at least she's got enough common sense to know what it takes to get results. Doesn't mean she's gonna be friendly about it, though.

[From in-game bio]
